gripOrHq.title: Karl de Veres, Corporate Stooge
gripOrHq.rulesText: Gain [1] after each successful run. Only one unique card of a particular name can be in play at a time. If for some reason more than one is in play, trash all but one.

gripOrHq.title: Wrecking Ball
gripOrHq.rulesText: [0]: Break wall subroutine. [2]: +1 strength. Whenever you break a wall subroutine with Wrecking Ball, lose [1] from a stealth card.

gripOrHq.title: Redecorator
gripOrHq.rulesText: [1]: Break up to two sentry subroutines on a single piece of ice. [3]: +1 strength

gripOrHq.title: Morphing Tool
gripOrHq.rulesText: [2]: Break a subroutine of the type last chosen for Morphing Tool. [1]: +1 strength. [1], A: Choose whether Morphing Tool breaks code gates, sentries, or walls. When you install Morphing Tool, choose whether it breaks code gates, sentries, or walls.

gripOrHq.title: Garbage In
gripOrHq.rulesText: After each successful run on R&D, give the Corp a Garbage counter. Two or more Garbage counters allow you to trash, at no cost, any cards accessed from R&D, even if the cards cannot normally be trashed. The Corp loses two Garbage counters after any run during which this ability is used. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

heapOrArchives.title: Disintegrator
heapOrArchives.rulesText: [2]: Derez a piece of ice and end your run. Use this ability only when you have just broken all the subroutines of that piece of ice and have successfully passed it.

heapOrArchives.title: Bulldozer
heapOrArchives.rulesText: [1]: Break wall subroutine. [2]: +1 strength. If Bulldozer breaks all the subroutines of a wall, and the next piece of ice encountered during this run is a sentry, break one of the subroutines of that sentry, at no cost. Whenever you break a wall subroutine with Bulldozer, lose a total of [2] from stealth cards.

heapOrArchives.title: Taxman
heapOrArchives.rulesText: After each successful run on HQ, give the Corp a Tax counter. Every two Tax counters cause the Corp to lose [1] at the start of each of its turns. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

heapOrArchives.title: Highlighter
heapOrArchives.rulesText: After each successful run on R&D, give the Corp a Highlighter counter. Each Highlighter counter after the first allows you to access an additional card from R&D whenever you access cards from R&D. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

heapOrArchives.title: Deck, The
heapOrArchives.rulesText: [0]: Base link 5. [1]: +1 link. Provides +1 MU. Use only one base link card for each trace attempt made against you. Only one deck can be in play at a time. Trash any older decks.

heapOrArchives.title: Highlighter

heapOrArchives.rulesText: After each successful run on Archives, HQ, or R&D, put a Socket counter in that data fort. Socket counter from Archives, Socket counter from HQ, and Socket counter from R&D: Give the Corp a Pipe counter. Each Pipe counter causes the Corp to forgo an action at the start of each of its turns. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

Whenever you break a wall subroutine with Bulldozer, lose a total of [2] from stealth cards.

heapOrArchives.title: Forward's Legacy
heapOrArchives.rulesText: [0]: Break sentry subroutine. At the start of each run, roll a die and add the result to Legacy's strength for that run.

heapOrArchives.title: Broker
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Each of your turns, you may take only one action to use Broker. A: Put [3] from the bank on Broker. A: Take all the bits from Broker.

scoreArea.title: Charity Takeover
scoreArea.rulesText: Gain [9] and 1 Bad Publicity point. If the Corp has 7 or more Bad Publicity points, it loses the game, even if it fulfills victory conditions at the same time.

scoreArea.title: Viral Breeding Ground
scoreArea.rulesText: When you score Breeding Ground, trash all cards installed in or on the fort Breeding Ground was installed in. When Runner accesses Breeding Ground, choose up to two programs for each advancement counter on Breeding Ground; Runner brings those programs into his or her hand.

scoreArea.title: Charity Takeover
scoreArea.rulesText: Gain [9] and 1 Bad Publicity point. If the Corp has 7 or more Bad Publicity points, it loses the game, even if it fulfills victory conditions at the same time.

scoreArea.title: Marked Accounts
scoreArea.rulesText: When Runner accesses Marked Accounts, give Runner a tag, even if it is not installed. If Marked Accounts is accessed from R&D, Runner must show it to you.

rig.title: Vienna 22
rig.rulesText: After each successful run on HQ, give the Corp a Vienna counter. Each Vienna counter allows you to access an additional card from HQ whenever you access cards from HQ. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

rig.title: Black Widow
rig.rulesText: [1]: Break sentry subroutine. [2]: +1 strength. Choose an installed piece of ice when you install Black Widow. Black Widow gets +5 strength during each encounter with that piece of ice.

rig.title: Cortical Stimulators
rig.rulesText: Prevents 1 Net or brain damage each turn.

rig.title: Cortical Cybermodem
rig.rulesText: Provides +2 MU and +2 hand size. Put [2] from the bank on Cortical Cybermodem when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for using icebreakers during runs. If you use any of these bits, replace them from the bank at the start of your next turn. Only one deck can be in play at a time. Trash any older decks.

rig.title: The Short Circuit
rig.rulesText: A, [1]: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Reshuffle your stack afterwards.

scoreArea.title: Corporate Headhunters
scoreArea.rulesText: Whenever Corporate Headhunters successfully does damage, Runner 's hand size is reduced by 1. A: Do 1 meat damage. Use this ability only if Runner is tagged.

root.title: Pattel Antibody
root.rulesText: When Runner accesses Pattel Antibody, you may pay [3] to put a Pattel counter on all installed icebreakers, even if Pattel Antibody is not installed. If Pattel Antibody is accessed from R&D, Runner must show it to you.

root.title: Doppelganger Antibody
root.rulesText: When Runner accesses Doppelganger Antibody, you may pay [2] to give Runner a Doppelganger counter, even if Doppelganger is not installed. root.rulesText: The difficulty of research agendas installed in this fort is reduced by 1. Rez a region when you install it. Install a region only if you can pay to rez it. Only one region may be installed in each fort. Trash older ones.

root.rulesText: The difficulty of Black Ops agendas installed in this fort is reduced by 1. Rez a region when you install it. Install a region only if you can pay to rez it. Only one region may be installed in each fort. Trash older ones.

root.title: Department of Misinformation
root.rulesText: You may rez Department of Misinformation when Runner attempts to expose a card. [1]: Prevent a card from being exposed.
